def dfs(ans, rem, p):
    global res
    if ans > res:
        return
    if rem == 0:
        res = min(ans, res)
        return
    need = rem // xrr[p]
    dfs(ans + (p * need), rem - (need * xrr[p]), p - 1)
    dfs(ans + p * need, need * xrr[p] - rem, p - 1)
